title: Quantum algorithm for Clifford multiplication
summary: Given two dense multivectors of the Clifford algebra $C\ell(V, Q)$ with $N=2^{p+q}$ coefficients, the fastest known classical algorithms compute their geometric product in $O(N^{ω/2})$ arithmetic operations, where $ω$ denotes the matrix multiplication exponent. I show that, under amplitude encoding, a quantum computer executes the geometric product in $O(\operatorname{polylog} N)$ time, using logarithmic space with sublogarithmic circuit depth.
